warning a11y_click_events_have_key_events 36:1-40:3 Visible, non-interactive element `<enhanced:img>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events
warning a11y_no_static_element_interactions 36:1-40:3 `<enhanced:img>` with a click handler must have an ARIA role
    https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_static_element_interactions
